title: Saudi Arabian Spicy Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavorful and spicy dish from the Middle East, featuring tender lamb kebabs marinated in a blend of aromatic spices.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Make sure to pat dry the lamb cubes before marinating

ingredients.name: Yogurt
ingredients.notes: You can use plain or flavored yogurt

ingredients.name: Spice blend (e.g. garam masala, cumin, coriander, cinnamon)
Red pepper flakes
ingredients.notes: Use more or less depending on your desired level of heat

ingredients.name: Ginger paste
ingredients.notes: You can make your own or use store-bought

ingredients.name: Garlic, minced
ingredients.notes: Use 1-2 cloves depending on your desired level of garlic flavor

ingredients.name: Vegetable oil
ingredients.notes: For brushing the grill or cooking pan

instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine yogurt, spice blend, red pepper flakes, lime juice, ginger paste, garlic, salt, and black pepper. Blend until smooth.
Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and mix until they are fully coated. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat. Remove the lamb cubes from the marinade, allowing any excess to drip off.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube. Brush the grill or cooking pan with vegetable oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until they are cooked through and slightly charred.
Transfer the kebabs to a serving platter and garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
Serve hot with your favorite sides, such as rice, salad, or grilled vegetables.
